versions.content: Th e range of the PN request information in the NM user data is defined by the parameters FrNmPnInfoOffset and FrNmPnInfoLength . Each bit in the PN range shall have the following meaning: Bit value Meaning: 0 - > The PN is not requested 1 - > The PN is requeste d Note : FrNmPnInfoOffset + FrNmPnInfoLength shall not exceed the Length of the NM PDU.
